'''Xot's Megabar''' was a huge three-story [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that barely fit within the boundaries of the [[Belgar Spaceport|spaceport]] in the city of [[Belgar]] on the rugged planet [[Belgaroth]]. It was the only drinking establishment within easy walking distance from the spaceport. Therefore, everyone who landed on the planet and wanted a drink or a bite to eat eventually ended up at Xot’s bar. Next to the bar stood two single-story buildings where [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] could spend the night for a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The identity of the [[Xot (individual)|owner]] remained a mystery, and none of the patrons knew exactly who he was. Local criminal elements often visited Xot’s bar and were well informed about all the underworld affairs of Belgaroth.

==Behind the scenes==
Xot’s Megabar was conceived in the sourcebook [[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]] {{C|[[2003]]}} for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. In the informational section about the planet [[Belgaroth]], a brief entry is given about the bar and other locations associated with the planet. The sourcebook suggested beginning one of the game scenarios – «An Unexpected Stop» – at the Belgar spaceport, specifically in Xot’s Megabar.
